name: counter-visual-gate-08a
status: Visual Gate candidate (ACTION-08A). Provisional Counter / hiki-sabaki pose for the User Visual Gate; not an accepted Product art contract.
note: One authored red Counter pose is the only source. It is normalized like the accepted idle red (one whole-sprite rotation so FRONT = local +X, explicit root, body core = 2R, exact /4 downscale). Blue reuses the accepted red -> blue rule of runtime_wrestler_recipe.json (single owner): local-Y reflection ((x, y) -> (x, H - y)) + mawashi-only recolor. Counter has no hand semantics, so one red pose and its reflected blue are enough.

measurement.method: Same landmark registration as the Product Tsuppari poses (measure_tsuppari_pose.measure_landmarks / normalization, run once for this candidate): hair blob and mawashi centroids at 1/2 BOX scale registered to the accepted idle red master; rotation delta = angle(H -> B) - idle angle(H -> B); scale s = mean(sqrt(hair area ratio), sqrt(mawashi area ratio)); idle root / body core carried by s * Rot(delta) about the H/B midpoint; source_front_deg = idle 160.7 + delta. Recorded values rounded: front 0.1 deg, points 1 px.

measurement_evidence.candidate: ACTION-08A1 lateral-sweep candidate (replaces the ACTION-08A pose, rejected as too similar to Tsuppari).
measurement_evidence.note: The torso is drawn turned ~18 deg; the head is drawn large relative to the body, so the two area ratios disagree (hair sqrt ratio 1.317, mawashi 1.009) and s is their mean.

mask_limits.note: Validation of the accepted hue-band + largest-component mawashi mask at runtime scale (fail closed). missed = band pixels outside the largest component. max_missed_px 80 (ACTION-08A1, Counter gate only, image-specific): the candidate's missed pixels are semi-transparent outline fringe, not a disconnected mawashi part; not a global Product-art standard.
